findings.title: Container connects to a Service with no ready pods
findings.cause: container web exits because Service db refuses its connection: the Service has no ready pods (no pod has its selector's labels app=db); its log says: "wget: can't connect to remote host (10.96.36.229): Connection refused"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
calling db
wget: can't connect to remote host (10.96.36.229): Connection refused

evidence.what: Service db has no ready pods: no pod has its selector's labels app=db

findings.fix: Fix Service db's pods (the findings for them say why they are not ready, or scale them up), or make web wait and retry rather than exit.
